annotation.title_clean: A Call to Uruguay to Sign and Ratify the International Treaty on AI, Human Rights, Democracy, and the Rule of Law
annotation.title_en: A Call to Uruguay to Sign and Ratify the International Treaty on AI, Human Rights, Democracy, and the Rule of Law
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Center for AI and Digital Policy (CAIDP)
annotation.venue: Center for AI and Digital Policy
named_instruments_referenced: Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: CAIDP statement urging Uruguay to sign and ratify the Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI. It cites Uruguay's National AI Strategy 2024-2030 and regional leadership, summarizes the treaty's principles and safeguards, and urges full private-sector inclusion. No robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Urges Uruguay to sign and ratify the Council of Europe AI Treaty
Uruguay's National AI Strategy 2024-2030 already aligns with human-rights principles
Treaty requires transparency, accountability, non-discrimination, privacy and impact assessments
Safeguards include contestability, redress, and notice of AI interaction
Calls for full inclusion of the private sector under treaty provisions
